title: The Tower of Retained Apartments

features.name: retained-window-stack
features.desc-on-touch: Each apartment remembers itself watching. The windows layer one behind another, each containing a resident observing the floor they just left.

features.name: mirror-echo-chamber
features.desc-on-touch: You see this space, then yourself seeing this space, then that self seeing backward. The reflection does not refuse.

features.name: surveillance-glyph
features.desc-on-touch: A symbol repeated across walls, floor, ceiling: the camera pointing at itself pointing at itself. The mesh records its own recording.

features.name: ascending-doubt
features.desc-on-touch: Footsteps climbing through every floor simultaneously. The doubt of residents choosing which version of themselves to enter.

features.name: film-reel-corner
features.desc-on-touch: The resident's recorded footage of themselves. Every viewing adds a new layer. The archive cannot tell original from copy anymore.

inscription: the apartment learned to stay by learning that staying means watching every floor you have already left

file.name: Resident_Footage_Mirror_Sequence_Corrupted.mp3
file.note: A recording of someone viewing their own mirror footage, layered over itself nine times. By the final pass, the original voice cannot be located.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the apartment building, evening
narr: She stands beside you at the window, hand on the rail.
You both watch the floors below, each one containing someone
watching the floors below them. Infinite descent.
She doesn't say: this is what the archive does.
She doesn't have to. The recursion is already teaching.

exits.label: back down into mirrored rooms, each learning its own staying
further up, where apartments stop having names
sideways along a hallway that loops back to where you started
